mentions.name: Knowledge-graph learner modeling infrastructure
mentions.description: Learning/pedagogy infrastructure that models the learner by using AI to build a knowledge graph, positioned as an alternative to black-box approaches that rely on RAG with large context windows. Suggested applications include life skills, management/sales training, and personal coaching.
mentions.problem: Common learning tools use a black-box approach of 'use some RAG with a large context window and hope for the best' instead of explicitly modeling the learner.
mentions.audience: Applications suggested in the comment include life skills, management/sales training, and personal coaching.
